poster_title: Youtu-GraphRAG: Vertically Unified Agents for Graph Retrieval-Augmented Complex Reasoning
authors: Junnan Dong, Siyu An, Yifei Yu, Qian-Wen Zhang, Linhao Luo, Xiao Huang, Yunsheng Wu, Di Yin, Xing Sun
paper_info: Tencent Youtu Lab, Monash University, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, 2025

panels.headline: GraphRAG enhances LLMs in complex reasoning by organizing fragmented knowledge into structured graphs.
content: GraphRAG integrates graph construction and retrieval to improve complex reasoning.
Current methods focus on either graph construction or retrieval, leading to suboptimal performance.
Domain shifts pose challenges for existing GraphRAG frameworks.
Proposed framework aims to address these limitations.
Introduces a unified paradigm for superior complex reasoning.

panels.headline: Proposed a vertically unified Agentic GraphRAG framework.
content: Seed graph schema ensures targeted entity, relation, and attribute types.
Dually-perceived community detection algorithm creates hierarchical knowledge tree.
Agentic retriever transforms complex queries into parallel sub-queries.
Tailored anonymous dataset prevents LLM knowledge leaking.
Anonymity Reversion task ensures fair evaluation.
panels.figure_caption: Toy overview of Youtu-GraphRAG that unifies graph construction and retrieval through a schema-guided agentic paradigm.

panels.headline: Conducted across six challenging benchmarks.
content: Evaluated robustness and performance of Youtu-GraphRAG.
Benchmarks include tasks requiring complex multi-hop reasoning and domain transfer.
Compared with state-of-the-art baselines.
Demonstrated significant improvements in token costs and accuracy.
Showed adaptability in unseen domains.
panels.figure_caption: Contrasts three query-resolution strategies for a multi-hop question: embedding matching, traditional agents, and agentic decomposer.

panels.headline: Achieved 90.71% saving in token costs and 16.62% higher accuracy.
content: Youtu-GraphRAG outperformed state-of-the-art baselines.
Demonstrated remarkable adaptability in domain transfer.
Lowered token costs while maintaining high performance.
Effective in moving the Pareto frontier.
Provided detailed performance comparisons over benchmark datasets.
panels.figure_caption: Youtu-GraphRAG effectively moves the Pareto frontier with lower token costs and higher performance.

panels.headline: Introduced a unified Agentic GraphRAG framework.
content: Unified graph construction and retrieval for robust reasoning.
Developed a theoretically-grounded community detection algorithm.
Proposed a tailored anonymous dataset and Anonymity Reversion task.
Conducted extensive empirical experiments across diverse tasks and domains.
Showed state-of-the-art performance in complex reasoning.

panels.headline: Youtu-GraphRAG enhances complex reasoning capabilities.
content: Effectively unifies graph construction and retrieval.
Improves adaptability and efficiency in unseen domains.
Suitable for real-world applications requiring robust reasoning.
Future work includes further optimization and exploration of new domains.
